services.name: 37 Performance Cruiser
services.desc: This big performance cruiser is well built, beautifully finished, and easy on the eye. Her luxurious interior with ultra-leather seating, furniture-quality woodwork should satisfy the most demanding buyers. The interior is open with great headroom, full galley, large head compartment, and central vacuum. The exterior features include wraparound cockpit seating, double-wide helm seating, walk-thru windshield, foredeck sun pads, power engine hatch, and transom storage locker. Additional amenities include; Kohler 7.5kw genset with 490 hours, and marine air conditioning. The Company offers the details of this vessel in good faith but cannot guarantee or warrant the accuracy of this information
